On-device text recognition uses these unmodified third-party components:

Tesseract.js 7.0.0
https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
License copied by the build to ocr/tesseract-LICENSE.txt.

Tesseract.js-core (exact version pinned in package-lock.json)
https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
License copied by the build to ocr/core-LICENSE.txt.
Only LSTM variants are included, including SIMD and relaxed-SIMD variants.

English 4.0.0_best_int trained data, @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0
https://github.com/naptha/tessdata
The upstream trained-data repository is Apache-2.0 licensed.
Its license is retained in tessdata-LICENSE.txt.
The npm packaging metadata additionally lists MIT.

All recognition happens in the user's browser. No uploaded images or recognised
text are sent to these projects or to third-party OCR services.
